settings.subtitle: Answers to common questions about IYOVA products, orders, and care.

settings.content:
Products & usage

How often should I use my IYOVA device?
We recommend following the guided ritual in your product manual — typically 3–5 minutes per session, several times per week.

Is IYOVA suitable for sensitive skin?
Our devices are designed with multiple intensity settings. Start on the lowest setting and consult your dermatologist if you have specific concerns.

Orders & shipping

When will my order ship?
Orders are processed within 1–2 business days. You'll receive tracking information once your package is on its way.

Can I change or cancel my order?
Contact us as soon as possible — we'll do our best to accommodate changes before your order ships.

Warranty & support

How do I register my warranty?
Visit our Warranty Registration page with your product serial number and purchase details.
